scripts.android:apk: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && echo '\n✅ APK built at: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
scripts.android:aab: cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd .. && echo '\n✅ AAB built at: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab'
scripts.ios:release: node scripts/timed-run.js react-native run-ios --scheme warrendeleon-Prod --mode Release
scripts.ios:pods: cd ios && bundle exec pod install && cd ..
scripts.clean: yarn clean:android && yarn clean:ios && yarn clean:node
scripts.clean:ios: rm -rf $HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/warrendeleon-* && cd ios && rm -rf Pods build && cd .. && yarn ios:pods
scripts.validate: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test
scripts.detox:ios:mock-validation: DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=ios.sim.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags @mock-validation --fail-fast --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.detox:ios:test: DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=ios.sim.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags 'not @mock-validation' --fail-fast --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.detox:android:mock-validation: DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=android.emu.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags @mock-validation --fail-fast --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.detox:android:test: DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=android.emu.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags 'not @mock-validation' --fail-fast --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.e2e:ios: yarn detox:ios:build && yarn detox:ios:mock-validation && yarn detox:ios:test
scripts.e2e:android: yarn detox:android:build && yarn detox:android:mock-validation && yarn detox:android:test
scripts.detox:ios:boot-simulators: bash -c 'xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro" 2>/dev/null || true; for i in $(seq 1 ${DETOX_WORKERS:-2}); do xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro-Detox" 2>/dev/null || true; done; sleep 3'
scripts.detox:ios:test:parallel: yarn detox:ios:boot-simulators && DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=ios.sim.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags 'not @mock-validation' --parallel ${DETOX_WORKERS:-2} --retry 1 --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
scripts.detox:android:test:parallel: DETOX_LOGLEVEL=error DETOX_CONFIGURATION=android.emu.debug TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.cucumber.json cucumber-js --tags 'not @mock-validation' --parallel ${DETOX_WORKERS:-2} --retry 1 --format ./src/test-utils/cucumber/formatters/CheckmarkFormatter.js --require-module ts-node/register --require-module tsconfig-paths/register 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.feature' --require 'src/test-utils/cucumber/**/*.{ts,tsx}' --require 'src/features/**/__tests__/*.cucumber.{ts,tsx}'
